# ToolBar markup reference

ToolBar bands, groups, and items.

### ToolBarBand

Receiver: `ToolBarBand`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Group(params ToolBarEntry[] entries)` |  | Adds a group holding the given entries. |

### ToolBarGroup

Receiver: `ToolBarGroup`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Host(Element content)` |  | Adds an entry hosting an arbitrary element. |
| `Item(Command command)` |  | Adds an entry that runs a command. |
| `Item(Command command, object data, IconTemplate icon = null)` |  | Adds an entry that runs a command with data as the invocation argument, so several entries can share one command and differ only in the value they pass. |
| `Items(params Element[] elements)` | `Items` | Adds the given elements as entries, each hosted as it is. For a toolbar built from controls rather than from commands: the elements keep their own content, handlers and bindings, and the band collapses them into its overflow popup like any other entry. |
| `Label(string text)` |  | Adds static text annotating the entry beside it. |
| `Menu(string text, Menu menu, IconTemplate icon = null)` |  | Adds an entry with no primary action that opens a menu. |
| `Separator()` |  | Adds a rule dividing the entries before it from the ones after. |
| `Split(Command command, Menu menu)` |  | Adds an entry that runs a command and opens a menu from its chevron. |
| `Toggle(Command command, bool isChecked = false)` |  | Adds an entry that stays visibly pressed while its state is on. |
| `Toggle(Command command, object data, IconTemplate icon = null)` |  | Adds a toggle entry that runs a command with data as the invocation argument. |

### ToolBarEntry

Receiver: `ToolBarEntry` and derived types (`where T : ToolBarEntry`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `ToolTip(Element value)` | `ToolTip` | Sets ToolTip. What to show when the pointer rests on this entry. Content, not a policy: when it is left empty the entry builds one from its command according to ItemToolTipMode. |
| `ToolTip(string text)` | `ToolTip` | Sets what this entry shows when the pointer rests on it, instead of what its command would say. |

### ToolBarHost

Receiver: `ToolBarHost`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Content(Element value)` | `Content` | Sets the hosted element. |

### ToolBarItem

Receiver: `ToolBarItem` and derived types (`where T : ToolBarItem`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BindCommand(ObservableValue<Command> source)` | `bind Command` | Binds the command this entry runs. |
| `Command(Command value)` | `Command` | Sets the command this entry runs. |
| `CommandData(object value)` | `CommandData` | Sets CommandData. The value the entry hands its command as the invocation argument, or null to let the nearest argument source supply one. Entries that share a command and differ only in this value show their own Text and Icon. |
| `Icon(IconTemplate value)` | `Icon` | Sets Icon. Icon shown instead of the command's own, or null to show the command's. |
| `Presentation(CommandPresentationMode presentation)` | `Presentation` | Sets how this entry shows its command, overriding the toolbar's own presentation. |
| `Presentation(CommandPresentationMode? value)` | `Presentation` | Sets Presentation. How this entry shows its command, or null to follow ItemPresentation. |
| `Text(string value)` | `Text` | Sets Text. Text shown instead of the command's own, or null to show the command's. |

Receiver: `ToolBarLabelItem`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|

### ToolBarToggleItem

Receiver: `ToolBarToggleItem`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BindIsChecked(ObservableValue<bool> source)` | `bind IsChecked` | Binds whether this entry reads as on. Two-way: the toolbar writes the entry back when the button it made is pressed, so the bound value follows the user as well as the application. |
| `IsChecked(bool value = true)` | `IsChecked` | Sets whether the entry reads as on. |

### ToolBar

Receiver: `ToolBar`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Band(params ToolBarGroup[] groups)` |  | Adds a band holding the given groups. |
| `Bands(params ToolBarBand[] bands)` | `Bands` | Sets the bands, top to bottom. |
| `CanReorderGroups(bool value = true)` | `CanReorderGroups` | Sets CanReorderGroups. Whether groups may be dragged into a different place. This is a capability, not a mode: a press still runs the entry, and only a drag from a group's grip moves it. On by default, as a toolbar with grips has been since the toolbars this one is modelled on; turn it off for a fixed one and the grips go with it. |
| `ItemPresentation(CommandPresentationMode value)` | `ItemPresentation` | Sets ItemPresentation. How entries show their commands unless the entry overrides it. |
| `ItemToolTipMode(CommandToolTipMode value)` | `ItemToolTipMode` | Sets ItemToolTipMode. What the entries build a tooltip from when the entry supplies none. Decided here rather than per entry: a toolbar that says one thing about half its buttons and another about the rest is harder to read than either. Defaults to everything the command can say, because an icon-only entry shows no name at all. |
| `OnGroupsReordered(Action handler)` | `event GroupsReordered` | Subscribes handler to GroupsReordered. Raised after a drag has moved a group, once Bands holds the new layout. |
